## Overview

Add opt-in `--dcp-comm-backend fi_a2a_fused` for MLA and FlashInfer GQA/MQA decode. It calls `decode_cp_a2a_lse_reduce` to exchange partial attention outputs and perform LSE-weighted reduction in one operation, reading vLLM's output/LSE views without layout copies.

**Draft:** depends on [FlashInfer #6483](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/6483), which extends the NCCL implementation from [#4929](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/4929) with mask and stride support. The repository's pinned dependencies cannot run this path. Dependency pins are unchanged; a supported minimum version will be selected after [FI #6483](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/6483) is released and qualified.

## Claims

- Wire the backend into the MLA manager and FlashInfer GQA/MQA decode dispatcher. Existing defaults, Q/KV partitioning and prefill paths requiring merged LSE are preserved.
- Pass destination-major O and independently strided LSE through tensor views. FI receives the existing LSE log base and a source-rank token-validity mask.
- Use one `DCPValidTokenMask` helper across dense MLA, sparse MLA and FlashInfer metadata builders. Each builder owns its persistent buffer; existing normal, capture and drafting paths refresh it, including empty shards and graph padding. `AttentionGroup` and `CommonAttentionMetadata` are unchanged.

## Validation

| Check on the current source | Result |
|---|---|
| Local configuration/reference, metadata and worker utility tests | 114 passed, 51 skipped, 13 deselected |
| CUDA metadata tests; 2 × H100 80GB visible, TP=2 fixture | 19 passed, zero skips |
| Scoped pre-commit, including Ruff/mypy, and diff checks | Passed |

### Test commands

Local:

```sh
.venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/distributed/test_dcp_a2a.py \
  tests/v1/attention/test_flashinfer_dcp_spec_reorder.py \
  tests/v1/attention/test_mla_noncausal.py \
  tests/v1/worker/test_attn_utils.py \
  -q --confcutdir=tests/v1/attention -k 'not TestPackedA2AKernels'
```

GPU metadata:

```sh
.venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/v1/attention/test_flashinfer_dcp_spec_reorder.py \
  tests/v1/attention/test_mla_noncausal.py \
  tests/distributed/test_dcp_a2a.py::test_fi_dcp_valid_token_mask_reuses_storage \
  -q -s -ra -x --confcutdir=tests/v1/attention
```

## Details

The adapter lives in `vllm/v1/attention/ops/flashinfer_dcp.py`; mask allocation/update is owned by the DCP helper and uses the Triton metadata kernel. Workspace capacity includes speculative width and graph padding, with independent state per observed stream and existing microbatch slot.

The path requires SM90+, FP16/BF16 O, FP32 LSE, compatible PyTorch/NCCL device APIs, NCCL ≥2.29, DCP size 2–64 within one supported NCCL LSA domain, and PCP=1. GQA/MQA additionally requires the FLASHINFER attention backend, unquantized KV cache and no attention sinks; existing TP/KV-head constraints apply. Initialization requirements and explicit opt-outs for conflicting symmetric-memory collectives are documented in `docs/serving/context_parallel_deployment.md`.

Related work:

- [#48248](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48248) replaces exchange with `decode_cp_a2a_alltoall` and retains separate Triton combine. This PR includes reduction in the FI call.
- [#48196](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48196) targets sparse MLA projection/merge ordering and Helix exchange. This PR adds the fused-combine backend and its metadata integration.
- [#50484](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50484) provides the existing native direct symmetric-memory path, which remains a comparison baseline alongside packed NCCL.

Reviewer notes:

- Dependency:  [FI #6483](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/6483).
- Review mask lifetime/padding and workspace warmup. Each capture stream must be warmed on every rank.

@@ -51,6 +51,44 @@ In short, for decode context parallel, try to increase `-tp` size until you get
 
 Decode context parallel is supported in vLLM, for both MLA and GQA models. Some attention backends also support the combination of decode context parallel and MTP (multi-token prediction) to further accelerate the decoding phase.
 
+### FlashInfer fused DCP combine
+
+`--dcp-comm-backend fi_a2a_fused` enables FlashInfer's NCCL-based
+[fused output exchange and LSE reduction with mask/stride support (#6483)](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/6483)
+for MLA DCP and GQA/MQA decode with `--attention-backend FLASHINFER`.
+Existing defaults and GQA/MQA prefill remain unchanged. GQA/MQA initially
+requires an unquantized KV cache and no attention sinks; existing TP/KV-head
+DCP limits still apply. Speculative queries routed to prefill keep that path.
+
+Requires FlashInfer #6483, SM90+,
+NCCL >= 2.29 with device communicator support, FP16/BF16, 2–64 DCP ranks in one
+NCCL LSA/NVLink domain, and PCP=1.
+PyTorch must expose `NCCL_HAS_DEVCOMM` and
+`NCCLSymmetricMemory::get_window_offset`; the pinned Torch 2.13.0 build lacks them.
+
+The minimum supported FI release will be set once #6483 is released; until then,
+use its source changes in a compatible environment. FI reads O/LSE strided views
+and a token mask prepared by the metadata builder and shared across its layers;
+no O/LSE layout copy is needed.
+
+FI uses the process-wide NCCL symmetric-memory backend, so the following
+collective opt-outs are required:
+
+```bash
+VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM=0 \
+VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_Q_GATHER=0 \
+VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_KV_GATHER=0 \
+VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_A2A=0 \
+vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite \
+    --tensor-parallel-size 2 --decode-context-parallel-size 2 \
+    --dcp-comm-backend fi_a2a_fused --disable-custom-all-reduce \
+    --dtype bfloat16 --max-num-batched-tokens 256 --max-num-seqs 16
+```
+
+Keep CUDA graph warmups enabled: each capture stream needs an eager combine on
+all ranks before capture. Workspace memory scales with the scheduler token
+budget, graph padding, CUDA streams, and DBO slots.
+
 ## Technical Discussions
 
 The main discussions happen in the `#sig-context-parallel` channel of [vLLM Slack](https://slack.vllm.ai/).

+    if Version(version("flashinfer-python")) < Version("0.7.1rc5"):

+        raise RuntimeError("fi_a2a_fused requires SM90 or newer")

+    # Check the compiled PyTorch/NCCL interface before entering FI's collective
+    # allocation. An import alone does not prove these C++ APIs are available.
+    module = importlib.import_module("flashinfer.comm.dcp_lse_reduce")
+    if "mask" not in inspect.signature(module.decode_cp_a2a_lse_reduce).parameters:
+        raise RuntimeError("fi_a2a_fused requires FlashInfer #6483 mask/stride support")
+    spec = module.gen_dcp_lse_reduce_module()

+    # #4929's smallest workspace is 32 metadata bytes + 2*2*(16 O + 4 LSE).
+    if (

+    def __init__(

+            )

+        # communicator, which PyTorch creates on its first device collective.

+            group=group.device_group,
+            device_ids=[torch.accelerator.current_device_index()],

+                    self.heads_per_rank,
+                    self.world_size,
+                    self.head_dim,
+                    self.dtype,
+                    self.group.device_group,
+                )

+                output = torch.full(
+                    (1, self.world_size, self.heads_per_rank, self.head_dim),
+                    float("nan"),
+                    dtype=self.dtype,
+                    device=self.device,

+                    0.0,

+                    device=self.device,
+                ).transpose(1, 2)

+                    output,
+                    lse,
+                    workspace,
+                    self.rank,
+                    self.world_size,
+                    mask=torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.bool, device=self.device),
+                )

+                workspaces.append(workspace)
+            self._streams[stream_id] = stream
+            self._workspaces[stream_id] = workspaces
+
+    def lse_reduce(
+        self,
+        partial_output: torch.Tensor,
+        partial_lse: torch.Tensor,
+        is_lse_base_on_e: bool,
+        seq_lens: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        query_start_loc: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        valid_token_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Exchange destination-major vLLM heads and return the merged output."""
+        from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp import _validate_dcp_empty_shard_args
+        from vllm.v1.worker.ubatching import dbo_current_ubatch_id
+
+        expected_heads = self.heads_per_rank * self.world_size
+        if (
+            partial_output.ndim != 3
+            or partial_output.shape[1:] != (expected_heads, self.head_dim)
+            or partial_lse.shape != partial_output.shape[:2]
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("FI DCP expects O [B, N*H, D] and LSE [B, N*H]")
+        num_tokens = partial_output.shape[0]
+        if not 0 < num_tokens <= self.max_num_tokens:
+            raise ValueError("FI DCP input token count exceeds workspace capacity")
+        if partial_output.dtype != self.dtype or partial_lse.dtype != torch.float32:
+            raise ValueError("FI DCP requires the workspace output dtype and FP32 LSE")
+        if partial_output.device != self.device or partial_lse.device != self.device:
+            raise ValueError("FI DCP inputs must be on the workspace device")
+        if (
+            _validate_dcp_empty_shard_args(seq_lens, query_start_loc)
+            and valid_token_mask is None
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "FI DCP requires valid_token_mask prepared by the metadata builder"
+            )
+        if valid_token_mask is not None and (
+            valid_token_mask.shape != (num_tokens,)
+            or valid_token_mask.dtype != torch.bool
+            or valid_token_mask.device != self.device

+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "FI DCP token mask must be contiguous bool [B] on the input device"
+            )

+        if not 0 <= ubatch < self.num_ubatches:
+            raise ValueError("FI DCP ubatch exceeds the reserved workspace slots")

+        stream_id = int(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device).cuda_stream)

+        # the NCCL readiness signals for those rows.
+        output = partial_output.unflatten(
+            1, (self.world_size, self.heads_per_rank)
+        ).transpose(1, 2)
+        lse = partial_lse.unflatten(
+            1, (self.world_size, self.heads_per_rank)
+        ).transpose(1, 2)
+        return self._fi.decode_cp_a2a_lse_reduce(
+            output,
+            lse,
+            self._workspaces[stream_id][ubatch],
+            self.rank,
+            self.world_size,
+            lse_mode="basee" if is_lse_base_on_e else "base2",
+            mask=valid_token_mask,
+        )

+    heads_per_rank: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+    dtype: torch.dtype,
+    num_ubatches: int,
+) -> FlashInferDCPWorkspace:
+    return FlashInferDCPWorkspace(
+        group, device, max_num_tokens, heads_per_rank, head_dim, dtype, num_ubatches
+    )
